articles.title: Reckitt (LSE:RKT) Stock May Be 32% Undervalued On Cash Flow
articles.summary: Reckitt Benckiser Group has delivered a 23.2% return over the past 3 years, which puts a spotlight on whether the current share price around £57.78 is supported by the cash the business can generate. For anyone looking at Reckitt Benckiser Group today, the key question is how the market price lines up with the value suggested by its future cash flows.
